user_saw: Post-upgrade Doctor could report success even when it could not read an enabled plugin’s required manifest.
summary: Post-upgrade Doctor now checks indexed manifests even without a stored hash and reports read failures as errors, while allowing Claude bundles to omit their optional manifest.
reasoning: The oldest available source already skipped the probe when the stored hash was empty and converted manifest read failures to null, which suppressed findings. The canonical-index refactor retained that logic, and the local history ends before its introduction, so I could not establish whether the probe shipped with the defect or an earlier change broke working behavior.
